description: This file contains the definition of the Banner class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Design namespace. The class manages banner CRUD operations including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving banners and their images in the OpenCart e-commerce system.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Model class for managing banners and banner images, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve banners and their associated images within the Opencart admin design module.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Inserts a new banner record into the database, along with associated banner images if provided.

parameters.data: array<string, mixed> - Associative array containing banner data such as name, status, and images.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Updates an existing banner record and its images based on the provided banner ID and data.

parameters.banner_id: int - The ID of the banner to update.
parameters.data: array<string, mixed> - Updated banner data and images.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Deletes a banner and its associated images from the database based on the banner ID.

parameters.banner_id: int - The ID of the banner to delete.

methods.name: getBanner
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific banner, including its attributes.

parameters.banner_id: int - The ID of the banner to fetch.

methods.name: getBanners
methods.description: Fetches a list of banners with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

parameters.data: array<string, mixed> - Options for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalBanners
methods.description: Returns the total number of banners available in the database.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image for a specific banner and language.

parameters.banner_id: int - The banner to which the image is associated.
parameters.language_id: int - The language of the image.
parameters.data: array<string, mixed> - Image data including title, link, image path, and sort order.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Deletes all images associated with a specific banner.

parameters.banner_id: int - ID of the banner whose images are to be deleted.

methods.name: deleteImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes banner images associated with a specific language ID.

parameters.language_id: int - The language ID for which images should be deleted.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a specific banner, ordered by sort order.

parameters.banner_id: int - The ID of the banner.

methods.name: getImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches images associated with a particular language ID.
